header: An intro that stays while the list scrolls
lead: One column stays in place while the other holds up to twelve entries. Use it on long feature pages, so readers always see what the list is about.

items.title: Pinned on tablets and wider
items.text: On phones the columns stack and nothing is pinned.

items.title: Clear of the site header
items.text: The offset is the header’s height plus a gap, so the intro’s first line is never hidden.

items.title: Reverse moves the intro
items.text: The columns swap sides; the order in the HTML stays the same.

items.title: Three to twelve entries
items.text: With fewer than three there is nothing to scroll past the intro.

items.title: Entries can link
items.text: The whole row becomes the target, as in the other feature elements.
